summary.text: Cheryl Hewes is the Republican candidate for Maine State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Nicole Grohoski (D).
Ballotpedia lists her as a candidate in the 2024 Republican primary for Maine House of Representatives District 13, which she lost.

paragraphs.text: Hewes advanced from the Republican primary for Senate District 7 on June 9, 2026, with 3,182 votes in an uncontested primary.
